Greetings

There was a problem with my dogs getting along, and after consulting several behaviorists, I found Javier.
From our first meeting, I felt comfortable working with him. He's a very approachable person who is direct, sincere, and doesn't try to sugarcoat the problem or beat around the bush to get more money. He's a true professional with dogs; his years of experience are evident. He helps you every step of the way, and after a few sessions and with some work, we started to see results. Highly recommended—a great professional and an even better person.

I don't usually write negative reviews, and in fact, this experience happened in 2022. But recently, a friend asked me for recommendations of dog trainers in the area and specifically mentioned Javier because she had seen very good reviews about him. When I told her about our experience, I realized that many people who have had a bad experience, like we did, probably never leave a public review. And I think that also distorts the true image of the service.

That's why I've decided to share what we went through, so that anyone looking for help can compare different experiences before making a decision.

On August 3, 2022, we contacted Javier to discuss how to work with a fearful and reactive dog. We were having problems at home and on the street. Before the visit, we clearly explained the situation, and he told us that, in these cases, he would come to the home to assess the dog's behavior.

As soon as he entered the house, our dog reacted with extreme fear to a stranger and began barking constantly. Javier asked us to put him in a room. The dog spent the entire visit barking, scratching at the door forcefully, and trying to open it due to the stress and fear he was experiencing. He even damaged the wood and the doorknob.

For practically the entire session, I had to hold the doorknob to prevent him from leaving, while Javier conducted the assessment right there, having only seen the dog for two minutes upon entering, when he was overwhelmed by fear, and then for a whole hour completely agitated on the other side of the door.

Most of the visit consisted of fairly basic recommendations: getting him used to a muzzle, changing the harness for a buckle collar, etc. Finally, his conclusion was that the dog was "very aggressive," that he would only cause us problems, and that we should take him to a shelter; and that, if they wouldn't accept him, we should leave him tied up at the door. He even mentioned that, years ago, he would have recommended having him euthanized, although "it's not possible now."

Then he asked us to pay for the session via Bizum (€50) and left. At the time, we were so upset by the situation and his comments that we paid without thinking twice. Honestly, today I wouldn't have paid him a single cent for that visit.

Our dog is still with us, and thanks to other specialized dog trainers, he has improved tremendously over time.

Furthermore, all the professionals we've spoken to since agreed on one thing: none of them would have entered the home of an unknown dog previously described as fearful and reactive.

I can't comment on how he works with dogs without behavioral problems, but I would recommend seeking a second opinion if a professional suggests getting rid of the animal as their first solution.

What bothered me most wasn't just the diagnosis, but the way he handled the situation. Instead of acknowledging that it might not have been a case he could manage and ending the visit to avoid further stressing the dog, he continued the entire session so he could charge us while the animal was completely hysterical, locked in a room, barking and scratching incessantly on the other side of the door.

Our experience was very negative, and personally, I wouldn't recommend them for cases of fear or reactivity. I wouldn't want anyone else to go through a similar situation and see a dog, who would have a chance with a real professional, end up abandoned or dead because of a recommendation like that.

[Edited 5/21/26 to clarify Educagos' response: Due to an unforeseen situation, the dog got scared and bit my husband, leaving a mark (not a serious wound, no stitches). After that incident, both of them felt insecure around each other. My husband received some growls and a few swipes of his mouth. At no point had we feared that the dog would attack my son or me. We didn't want my husband's situation to escalate, hence the reason for hiring a trainer.]

Blas is a puppy who was separated from his mother very early. He doesn't know how to socialize with other dogs and is somewhat wary of people. Luckily, we contacted Javier, and we couldn't have made a better choice. With a lot of patience and practice, he has guided us in improving Blas's behavior in situations that upset him, teaching him to manage his emotions and showing us the importance of the bond between humans and dogs. Our puppy still has a way to go, but with everything he's learned thanks to Javier, we're sure we're on the right track. 💪🦮🐶
I recommend hiring Xavier's services. His classes, guidelines, and advice are very helpful. In our case, with a golden retriever puppy, they have helped us progress in its upbringing and training.

Javier was always very kind, but firm in his teaching methods. Our little dog, although small, is very reactive, and we didn't know how to manage his behavior. After eight lessons, we've learned to understand him better and manage his walks in a way that doesn't cause him anxiety or stress. We will continue to put his advice into practice to improve his behavior and help him become less reactive.
Great job with Xavi! We'll keep going!
The classes were very well run for better learning. I am particularly grateful.

Very pleased with the support that Xavi has given us for the training of our Beagle.
Highly recommended for understanding attitudes, needs and communication with your pet.
A 10/10
A very good learning foundation to start raising Klay with good guidelines and instructions

He helped us a lot with our 9-year-old husky's reactivity issues. The first few lessons were very informative, and not only did he learn, but we did too. We will definitely be back for more lessons with him.
It was a pleasure, Javier is a true professional as well as an excellent person, I would encourage anyone to hire his services.
Affectionate, kind, professional, worth it

A very good trainer; you can see the patience and care he puts into working with the dogs. He explains everything clearly and gives easy-to-follow guidelines for home training. I've seen improvements since the first sessions, and he inspires a lot of confidence in me. I highly recommend him!

Xavier (Educagos) is an excellent trainer. From day one, he showed great patience, professionalism, and a deep understanding of canine behavior. He quickly gained my dog's trust, as well as mine, by explaining each step of the process clearly and practically. Thanks to his work, my dog ​​has improved tremendously in obedience and behavior. It's clear he loves what he does and truly cares about the well-being of animals. I highly recommend him!

Hello.
Three months ago we adopted Trufa, a 3-year-old Cocker Spaniel.
She came from a rural environment, and adapting to the city has been quite an adventure.
Xavi is a true professional. We hired him for private basic training sessions. It was a great decision, as he helped us understand her and taught us the necessary strategies and tools to manage her behavior. The sessions were fun and professional. We were able to put everything he explained into practice.
Now we need to consolidate all this work day by day, and in the future, we plan to do advanced group training. I highly recommend him.
Thank you, Xavi, for everything.
Thank you, Javier, for your great professionalism. You've finally helped my twelve-year-old dog overcome her anxiety, and as a result, we're both happier.

Honestly, my expectations were higher than those Javier shared. It's possible that our "learning" in the education or training of a canine species won't be exactly what we expected; in the end, learning is a matter of effort. I think we've filed away Javier's advice and comments, although Tula's behavior will be a constantly evolving process.

The experience has been very positive, and the problems I was having with my dog ​​are gradually being resolved thanks to the training I received in the dog training course. Thank you so much for your patience and your excellent techniques for training dogs.
It's been a fantastic experience! Thanks, Javier, for your guidance. We've managed to raise a well-balanced dog like Cinna, although we'll need to keep practicing. 😉 …

Nala is a very reactive adopted dog with other dogs. Xavier has helped us understand her behavior and given us tools to manage different situations in the urban environment. We still have a lot of work ahead of us to improve Nala's reactivity with other dogs, but now it's time to put everything we've learned into practice: managing tension on the leash, using scent games to distract her and calm her emotions, and employing positive reinforcement. He has treated Nala with great respect.

Thank you very much and have a great holiday! 😉
We are satisfied and our furry friend's behavior has improved a lot.

Andrés, thank you for your feedback and for the effort I know you're putting in. Keep it up!

Regards

Xavier has been with us for 8 sessions and has taught us to better understand our dog. She was reactive with other dogs and we didn't know how to manage it. Now we walk much calmer, we have bonded more with her and we have also worked on other aspects that worried us such as the bell or the muzzle. Super satisfied with the work done!!
And we have learned to have fun with the exercises he has taught us :)
Thank you Xavier for everything we've learned!!
Simply a special person who has helped me a lot in understanding my puppy's behavior. Highly recommended, and I'm sure we'll continue working together.

Very good trainer. A lot of experience, a very good teacher. You have to train dogs, it's essential. And with a person like Xavier, it's better. He makes you realize things that you don't see and helps you understand your dog better.

We are really very happy with Xavier, Draco is another, he has improved a lot and that was not an easy task since Draco is a very nervous Pinscher of almost 6 years old and had never received any type of training. Xavier has a lot of knowledge and experience and a lot of patience! He did a great job. Thank you very much for everything!!!!! We recommend him 1000%!!!
A wonderful person! My dog ​​is thrilled and in just four classes has learned everything essential for having a balanced and happy dog. I highly recommend it.

We had never owned a dog before and had no knowledge of proper training. There's a lot of conflicting information and misinformation online, so I think it's very important and necessary to have the help of a dog trainer like Javier. He taught us techniques for achieving desirable behaviors, reinforced what we were doing well, corrected what we were doing wrong, and cleared up many of our doubts.
Javier is a true professional; he teaches you to understand your dog and train him correctly and confidently.
Highly recommended!
Excellent service and an excellent person! She helped us tremendously in understanding how to manage the daily problems we might have with our puppy and how she thinks! Thank you!

Twelve sessions that allowed us to get to know our dog deeply and have helped us improve our bond and turn awful walks into wonderful experiences. We will always keep you in mind when we want to reinforce and work on other activities or behaviors. Thank you for everything!
Many thanks to Javier!! He was a huge help with our puppy. We were very pleased with his service; he's a true professional who knows what he's doing. Thank you!!!

We had a 3-month-old puppy and didn't know how to teach him to stay alone, to be calmer, and to behave on walks. We decided to contact Javier, and it was the best decision we could have made. From the very first moment, Javier showed great empathy and patience with our dog. He provided us with very effective tools so that our puppy could learn to be calm and behave appropriately, both at home and outside. Furthermore, Javier has a very pleasant and clear teaching style, which made us feel very comfortable throughout the entire process. We definitely recommend him 100%. Thank you, Javier, for all your help!
We did the puppy first walks package and it was really good. We learned a lot about puppies and dogs in general. 10 out of 10, I highly recommend it!

We're very happy with Javier's work; he's a true professional. He's helped us a lot with Coco, our medium-sized Schnauzer. Now he greets other dogs on the street and doesn't pull on the leash.
I highly recommend him! 👍 …

The work we've done with Javier has been amazing. Rufo used to pull on the leash constantly during walks; honestly, I was finding it hard to take him out, but now my little one and I really enjoy them.

Thank you.

I have a 5-year-old dog, Yuki, who was a sweetheart at home, with other people, even children, but when he saw another dog… he transformed. Barking, attempted attacks… it was maddening; neither he nor I enjoyed walks. I tried everything, but nothing worked, until I found Xavier.

From the very first session, I saw an incredible change, and as the days went by, Yuki improved even more. Day by day, I work with the advice and corrections he's taught me, and walks are now peaceful, with no stress or fear for either of us. I couldn't be more grateful!
An excellent and very satisfying experience for both me and my dog. We learned so much, and it gave us a lot of confidence and a great bond between my dog ​​and me. Thank you, Javier!

Xavier is a fantastic professional and a lovely person! He's taught us how to interpret many of our puppy's behaviors and given us tons of tips for training our dog to grow up happy in our family! We would definitely use his services again!! Thank you so much, Xavi!!!
Javier has been incredibly loving with my 3-month-old puppy. He's helped me understand his needs and taught me how to support him throughout this whole process. I'm so grateful for his work!

After 12 training sessions with our reactive dog, Javier has not only helped us improve our most problematic behaviors but has also strengthened the bond between us and our dog. Above all, I value how he has taught us to understand our companion. We know we still have a lot of work ahead of us, but thanks to his excellent work, the foundation is solid. We will always keep him in mind if we want to work on any new, specific aspects. A pleasure!

Although Javier has a lot of experience, his methodology is outdated and based on negative reinforcement, which is not what I wanted for my dog. For example, he once told me to pull on the leash to prevent her from stepping off the sidewalk, teaching her through discomfort instead of building trust. Also, when she was anxious on the street, he tapped her on the head to get her attention.

With these kinds of techniques, of course the dog obeys, but she does so out of fear, not because she's learning positively or because she trusts you. I expected something different, where my dog ​​would learn from a place of calm and positive emotions, not from the fear of having her leash pulled or being hit. This methodology is not what I was looking for.

I'm thrilled with Javier and his method. After eight behavior modification sessions, he's helped my dog ​​and me reconnect. After seven years of not being able to enjoy walks together because he pulled and I couldn't let him off the leash, thanks to Javier we've finally made it happen. I'm so grateful.

Xavier is lovely and a true professional.
The guidance he gave us was incredibly helpful and helped us understand our puppy a little better.

Xavi is a true professional with extensive experience with dogs. His patience and affection for the dogs mean you start seeing results from the very first session.

Thank you for helping us with Ron.

He's a very nice and polite person, and his work is fantastic. He's taught us how to train our dog with patience and love. I highly recommend him. His great professionalism and knowledge about dogs are evident from day one.

We are delighted with Javier. A magnificent dog trainer, very pedagogical when teaching us techniques to train our furry friend, Rauw.

By the way, Rauw quickly welcomed him into our group and misses him a lot. An excellent professional, with a lot of experience and an even better person. 100% recommended.
Javier, you're the best. You motivated Rubick and us. You also gave us the clues we need to follow and hope that we don't kill our dog. We are so grateful.

Super happy because Tor has made a big change, he is calmer and more attentive. Xavier made everything very easy for us, he explained many things to us with great patience. He is a lovely person and a great professional.

Very happy with the experience, my dog ​​(Tuco) is a dog that doesn't have any big problems (he used to pull on the leash) but I wanted to achieve a better relationship with him, I did 8 obedience sessions a month ago and with a little dedication Tuco pays more attention every day and I think we are getting along well. Highly recommended!!!

I got a beautiful Doberman because, being two years old, difficult, and sick, nobody wanted him. We both needed help. I couldn't take him out alone; he was untamable. So, on the verge of despair, I searched Google for various solutions. None of them convinced me until I found EducaGos. I've never made a better decision regarding my dog. It's helped me understand him, and for him to understand me. There's still a long way to go, but we can already enjoy going out and playing with other dogs. And I will definitely continue to use this wonderful service, which has taught me that there is always hope.
I recommend it 100%!

Thanks to Javier, we've learned to understand dog language, specifically with our American Staffordshire Terrier. I know it's all about not giving up on dogs with problems, and we're realizing that thanks to everything Javier taught us, our dog and we are doing much better.

I am very grateful to Mr. Javier for helping us with our American Staffordshire Terrier who had problems going outside and seeing other dogs. Now he can go out calmly and without problems. Thank you so much! ❤️😊 …
Javier helped us train our puppy Breni, always using good methods and making the sessions very enjoyable. We are very happy with the change in our little dog!

The truth is, from the first day we spoke, Xavier has been a very calm and knowledgeable person. We know we have a long road ahead with our Golden Retriever, Milo; but he has provided us with tools to understand our dog and, above all, what …
Thanks for everything, Javier. Mika is going to miss you a lot!!! And so will I, hahaha. 100% recommended!!!!

Xavier gives you confidence from the first minute. His expertise, calmness and friendliness make the sessions enjoyable and allow you to better understand your dog and improve your relationship with him. One of the things we liked the most …

I contacted Javier because my poodle was having a problem with her fears; she would tremble whenever she went outside and heard traffic noises. And I have to tell you that thanks to Javier's help and the work we've done over the past few …

We are delighted with the classes we've taken with Javier. We hired his services because Troy was very anxious when left alone at home, barking and scratching at doors. After a few sessions and working little by little, he stays alone without any problem. Javier is a delight and a true professional 👌🏼 …
